name: VAB APC

placement_rationale.text: VAB is a wheeled personnel carrier (12.7mm MG only) rather than a direct-fire platform, so its placement follows road-mobility troop-transport doctrine rather than tank ambush positioning. 6 km sits in the near-operational band, consistent with an attritable, easily sourced carrier whose relevance — per its own contrast_vs_traditional note — is volume and replaceability rather than surviving at the closest edge of the line. (Nudged 6→6.4 km from this category's shared round-number value so it doesn't literally coincide with side_a-armor-m113-apc on the map's distance axis — a small, deterministic spread within the same band, not a new plausibility claim beyond what's already argued above.)

representative_system: VAB APC — Wheeled armored personnel carrier
characteristics: Strength: Long operational range and good road speed relative to weight; simple maintenance
Limitation: Aging French 1970s design with light armor by current standards
Estimated quantity available: Donated numbers not fully disclosed
employment_notes: French-donated wheeled APC adding to the patchwork of donor-nation vehicle types Ukraine must maintain in parallel
contrast_vs_traditional: Like the M113, the VAB's continued relevance here has less to do with the wheeled-mobility doctrine it was designed around and more to do with being an attritable, easily sourced personnel carrier in a war that is consuming vehicles faster than any single donor nation's newest platforms can replace them.
